findings.evidence: Lines 73–77 use only `algebraMap ℚ K`, `Module.compHom`, and `lie_smul`; none requires field operations.
findings.fix: Generalize the signature to `[CommRing K] [Algebra ℚ K] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra K L]`; the characteristic-zero field use remains an automatic specialization.
findings.issue: `ratLieAlgebra` unnecessarily requires `[Field K] [CharZero K]`; its body only restricts scalars along an existing `ℚ`-algebra structure.

findings.evidence: Lines 275–279 derive exactly `IsNilpotent (ad K L e)` from `hα, heα` and `IsNilpotent (ad K L f)` from `hα.neg, hfα` before invoking this theorem.
findings.fix: Remove `he` and `hf` from the theorem arguments and derive them internally with `isNilpotent_ad_of_mem_rootSpace`, as `exists_lieEquiv_forall_mem_rootSpace` already does.
findings.issue: `weylAut_mem_rootSpace` asks callers for `he` and `hf`, although its existing root-space and nonzero-root hypotheses already imply both nilpotency facts.

summary: Two public APIs impose stronger hypotheses than their constructions require.
